prompt.prompt:
Use case: targeted whole-region game-map edit for green coverage balance. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: a complete architectural-diversity revision that should otherwise be preserved. Image2 is the USER'S BUILDING/VEGETATION STYLE REFERENCE and relative vegetation coverage comparator ONLY, never its camera/road layout.

Keep the entire Image1 region framing, camera, road geometry and architecture essentially unchanged. Preserve every building footprint, silhouette, height and roof form, all road widths/centerlines/junctions/edge exits, sidewalks, paved entrance paths and visible central driving corridors. DO NOT redesign the buildings or return to repeated cream apartments. Keep the glass office tower, L-shaped school/civic court, arched roof hall, columned stone public building, staggered slabs, pitched townhouses and low shops.

SINGLE CORRECTION: Image1 went TOO FAR toward hard paving and too little greenery. The user wants greenery comparable to Image2, with only about10% RELATIVE reduction — retain approximately90% of Image2's visual green proportion after accounting for the different area. That means a modest reduction from Image2, NOT removal of most vegetation. Compared to Image1, add a clear but restrained amount of ground-level greenery so the region has inhabited planted courtyards and breaks in excessive hardscape, while remaining much less park-dominated than the earlier rejected park map.

In Image1's existing open ground spaces, convert portions of the oversized paved residential/civic courts into SMALL designed planted lawns, low shrub beds, several medium deciduous courtyard trees, and one or two compact pocket gardens. In the upper-left/back blocks add planted residential courtyard gardens BETWEEN buildings with grass and narrow paths, retaining all building footprints. In the broad right-side school courtyard keep the sport court and all door-to-road routes, but convert some outer paving margins into low lawn/shrub beds with a few trees and benches. Around the lower-left arched hall/stone community building add discrete ground garden beds and a small lawn area at its existing side forecourt, leaving the main entrance paved. Make the townhouses have small real rear/side gardens. A few tree planting pools along roads have visible soil/short grass and low stone edging; keep road centerlines clear. Courtyard foliage should vary naturally, moderate greens and a few subtle flowering trees, not rows of identical balls or excessive pink flowers.
No giant ornamental park, pond, pavilion garden, continuous forest border or vegetation covering roofs. Do NOT convert all four corners into parks. No rooftop vegetation at all. Do NOT turn every open gap into green or blanket the streets. Balance urban building/hardscape density with small usable green spaces. Do NOT overfill with extra buildings or remove buildings to make parks.

Camera MUST remain Image1's fixed ORTHOGRAPHIC high view at62.5degrees ABOVE THE HORIZONTAL ground and azimuth45degrees, broad roofs, same world scale; no low-isometric/perspective from Image2. Preserve refined bright Japanese urban anime architecture, white/grey/cream stone and blue-grey glass, fixed screen-upper-left warm light with consistent soft cast/contact shadows. Do not change palette or add blue cast.
Native square transparent RGBA outside same region edge, no framing change/crop/rotation/warp, no diorama base, no checkerboard texture. No people, riders, cars, buses, labels, text, logo or UI. One entire coherent region, no separately generated/assembled building sprites. Architectural diversity is locked; only balance ground greenery toward the user's reference-relative modest10% reduction.
